title: Executive Dashboard
summary: Provides the manager Dashboard: clickable KPI strip, interactive line charts, coverage gaps, and a curated rearrangeable widget catalog.
coverage: Open findings, coverage gaps, and velocity
How managers should interpret trend changes

warning.title: IMPORTANT
paragraphs: Dashboard conclusions are only as reliable as underlying record and finding updates. Missing assignment, stale tests, or delayed remediation will distort KPI interpretation.

sections.title: Dashboard role
paragraphs: Dashboard is the manager-focused analytical surface in RAPTOR. It answers four questions in order: what is open and how bad it is, what has never been tested or is stale, whether opened findings are being closed, and who is carrying the load.
Use this page for coordination and prioritization. KPI tiles and widget rows deep-link into Security or Assets. It is not a replacement for detailed record editing or finding authoring.

sections.title: Data and refresh contract
paragraphs: Dashboard data is fetched from `GET /dashboard/data` under `view_dashboard` permission. The response includes slim records, pentest rows, applications, and a `findingsSummary` built from `pentest_findings` so managers see live finding counts rather than pentest-record flags.

Frontend refresh behavior is both automatic and manual. Data refresh runs every 60 seconds without blanking the page, and can also be triggered with Refresh. Arrange persists widget order and half/full span in the browser.

rows: Never-tested and stale coverage, tester workload, unassigned.
Open/closed counts, severity mix, weekly opened vs closed, recent findings.
Apps needing attention (open findings and untested in-scope hosts).

sections.title: KPI strip overview
paragraphs: The strip under the title contains five clickable metrics. Together they provide a compact posture summary for open risk, coverage gaps, velocity, and unassigned work.
Cards should be interpreted as a system. A single movement without the matching widget can lead to incorrect prioritization.

rows: `open` from findingsSummary; hint is critical + high
How much live risk is still open, and how severe it is.
hosts whose pentest status is not In Progress or Completed
Inventory that has not entered a test.
Completed tests whose `test_end_date` is older than 90 days
Hosts that were tested but not recently.
Closed count in the last five weekly buckets; hint is opened in that window
Whether remediation is keeping up with discovery.
Work with no owner. Managers can reassign from Security.

sections.title: Visual panels and intent
paragraphs: Widgets are a fixed catalog. Arrange mode reorders them and toggles half or full width. Layout is stored per user in the browser. Charts are stroke-only lines with hover counts; they are not filled area charts.

rows: Are we keeping up week by week?
How bad is the current open set?
What is still untested or stale?
Who is carrying load, including Unassigned?
What moved in the last 30 days?

sections.title: Manager usage pattern
paragraphs: Review open findings and severity first, then coverage gaps, then whether opened vs closed is balanced. Use tester workload to see Unassigned and concentrated load.
Click a metric or row to open Security or Assets. Managers reassign work; they do not file findings from this page.
